preconditions.description: The number of possible splits and the number of different monster types are between 1 and 105, inclusive.
Each monster ID in a split rule is between 1 and n, inclusive.
Each split rule has at least one monster and at least one diamond.

preconditions.expression: The sum of li across all split rules is at most 105
preconditions.description: The total number of monsters and diamonds across all split rules is at most 105.

postconditions.expression: For each monster, the output contains two integers: the smallest and the largest number of diamonds that can possibly be collected by starting with that monster.
postconditions.description: The output for each monster includes the smallest and largest possible number of diamonds, or -1 if no diamonds can be collected, or -2 if diamonds can be collected indefinitely.
